source: ns-3 TreeAllReduce (chunk-pipelined full-volume, post volume-fix + post local-rank-fix e1cdd9c) on --topology=switched; TRUE H200 fabric: --linksPerGpu=18 separate point-to-point NVLink4 lanes @ 170 Gbps each, spray-routed (128 KiB chunks round-robin), aggregate trunk 3060 Gbps; credits unconstrained (--vcCredits=104857600)
model: T = S(D) + 2*log2(N)*t_min_switch + alpha(N)*D/tree_bw; alpha(N) = STRUCTURAL busiest GPU<->NVSwitch trunk load in D units (1/2/3); the pipeline-fill residual is absorbed into the fitted pair, not modeled
fit_set: all points, relative-error weighted (1/T^2); N in {4,8,16,32} x 1-256 MB; TWO free constants (t_min_switch, tree_bw), joint LS
